Amafayela angaphezu kuka-4 MB: isitoreji sesikhashana se-Vercel Blob, ngaphansi kwegama elingahleliwe, elisuswe ngemva kokusetshenziswa.

strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].text: Lonke isiza lisebenza ngebhodi lokhiye, nesixhumanisi “Sokweqa okuqukethwe” nomugqa obonakalayo entweni esebenzayo. Ukulandelama kwamafayela kungashintshwa ngaphandle kokudonsa nokulahla, kusetshenziswa izinkinobho. strings.tools.ocr.name: Funda iskeni
strings.tools.ocr.tagline: Yenza umbhalo wedokhumenti eskeniwe noma esithombeni ukwazi ukusesheka futhi ukopisheke.
strings.tools.ocr.seoTitle: I-OCR yamahhala ku-inthanethi: yenza i-PDF eskeniwe ikwazi ukusesheka
strings.tools.ocr.seoDescription: Funda umbhalo we-PDF eskeniwe noma isithombe (OCR) ukuze ukwazi ukuwusesha, ukuwukopisha noma ukuwufunda ngokuzwakalayo. Izilimi ezingu-16, mahhala, idokhumenti ayilayishwa.
strings.tools.ocr.intro: Idokhumenti eskeniwe noma esithombeni isivele iyisithombe: ngeke ukwazi ukusesha igama noma ukukopisha umusho. Funda iskeni kubona zonke izinhlamvu (lokhu kubizwa nge-OCR) futhi kungeza umbhalo wangempela edokhumentini ngaphandle kokushintsha ukuthi ibukeka kanjani. Ukufunda kwenzeka kudivayisi yakho: idokhumenti yakho ayilayishwa. Imodeli yolimi olukhethiwe (ama-MB ambalwa) kuphela elayishwa kanye.

strings.tools.ocr.guide.faq[1].a: Cha: ukufunda kwenzeka ngokuphelele kudivayisi yakho. Kulayishwa imodeli yolimi kuphela, kanye.
